description: A Dart class for managing user data in a SQLite database, including initialization, CRUD operations, and table creation for user info and profiles.

classes.name: UserDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class providing database access for user-related data, handling creation, reading, updating, and deleting user info.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Lazy-initialized getter for the SQLite Database instance.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating it at the specified path and setting up onCreate and onOpen handlers.

methods.name: _createDB
methods.description: Creates initial tables in the database, including notes and profile tables.

methods.name: _ensureAdditionalTables
methods.description: Ensures the user profile table exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new user record into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user record by ID.
